gauge.source: the whizz-kids gauge with Y = 82.80 in place of 24.50
gauge.note: Y = 82.80 is the position the whizz-kids instance designates Super Intelligence. The offset from that instance is exact: 23(82.80-24.50)/84 years x 8400/23 days = 5830 days, the 23s cancelling, so this epoch is the whizz-kids epoch plus 5830 days. The year unit implied throughout is 8400/23 = 365.2174 days.

sampled.why: Instantiated across the whole key domain, not a sampled slice. No real-world targets are attached and none are claimed.
